post.description: Programmatic surface for ad-hoc connector invocation. Mirrors the call_connector conversation tool: applies the saved credential, audits as connector.invoked, and returns {status, headers, body, latency_ms} with truncation flags for response bodies > 8KB. Driver coverage at this surface is HTTP and GraphQL only — Postgres / SFTP / S3 connectors return a 422 envelope pointing at workflow-step authoring.

post.summary: Discover endpoints for a connector template or URL
post.description: Runs the multi-strategy discovery pipeline (OpenAPI direct → GraphQL introspection → Swagger UI scrape → llms.txt → HTML scrape → Playwright crawl) for the given template_id, ingestion_url, or base_url. Cached per-tenant for 24h in knowledge_sources; pass force_refresh:true to bypass.
